mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MATE_MEDIA ( mate_id, media_type, media_url, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{mateId}, #{mediaType}, #{mediaUrl}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT media_id AS mediaId, mate_id AS mateId, media_type AS mediaType, media_url AS mediaUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt FROM TB_MATE_MEDIA WHERE media_id = #{mediaId}

SELECT media_id AS mediaId, mate_id AS mateId, media_type AS mediaType, media_url AS mediaUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt FROM TB_MATE_MEDIA WHERE mate_id = #{mateId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT media_id AS mediaId, mate_id AS mateId, media_type AS mediaType, media_url AS mediaUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt FROM TB_MATE_MEDIA WHERE mate_id = #{mateId} AND media_type = 'IMAGE' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, media_id ASC LIMIT 1
